nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group and let $f : G \to \mathbb{C}$ be a nonzero function with discrete Fourier transform $\hat f$. Then $|G| \le |\{x \in G : f(x) \neq 0\}| \cdot |\{\psi : \hat f(\psi) \neq 0\}|$, where $\psi$ ranges over the additive characters of $G$.
nodes.title: Donoho–Stark uncertainty principle

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group, let $A \subseteq G$, and let $B$ be a set of additive characters of $G$ with $|A| \cdot |B| < |G|$. If $f : G \to \mathbb{C}$ vanishes outside $A$ and its discrete Fourier transform $\hat f$ vanishes outside $B$, then $f = 0$.
nodes.title: Functions with small support and small Fourier support vanish

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group and let $\psi$ be an additive character of $G$ with values in $\mathbb{C}$, that is, a map $\psi : G \to \mathbb{C}$ with $\psi(0) = 1$ and $\psi(a + b) = \psi(a)\psi(b)$. Then $|\psi(x)| = 1$ for every $x \in G$.
nodes.title: Characters of a finite abelian group have absolute value one

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group, let $f : G \to \mathbb{C}$, and let $B$ be a set of additive characters of $G$ such that the discrete Fourier transform $\hat f$ vanishes outside $B$. Then for every $x \in G$, $|f(x)|^2 \le \frac{|B|}{|G|} \sum_{y \in G} |f(y)|^2$.
nodes.title: Pointwise bound from a small Fourier support

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group, let $A \subseteq G$, let $B$ be any set of additive characters of $G$, and let $f : G \to \mathbb{C}$ vanish outside $A$, with discrete Fourier transform $\hat f$. Then $\sum_{\psi \in B} |\hat f(\psi)|^2 \le \frac{|A| \cdot |B|}{|G|} \sum_{\psi} |\hat f(\psi)|^2$, where the last sum runs over all additive characters $\psi$ of $G$.
nodes.title: Concentration bound for the Fourier transform of a function with small support

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group and $f : G \to \mathbb{C}$, with discrete Fourier transform $\hat f$. Then $\sum_{\psi} |\hat f(\psi)|^2 = |G| \sum_{x \in G} |f(x)|^2$, where $\psi$ runs over all additive characters of $G$.
nodes.title: Squared-norm Plancherel identity for the finite Fourier transform

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group, let $f : G \to \mathbb{C}$, and let $B$ be a set of additive characters of $G$ such that the discrete Fourier transform $\hat f$ vanishes outside $B$. Then for every $A \subseteq G$, $\sum_{x \in A} |f(x)|^2 \le \frac{|A| \cdot |B|}{|G|} \sum_{x \in G} |f(x)|^2$.
nodes.title: Concentration bound for a function with small Fourier support

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
